name: Tubbataha Reefs Natural Park
description: Tubbataha Reefs Natural Park sits in the middle of the Sulu Sea, about 150 km southeast of Puerto Princesa in the Philippines. Two vast atolls and a smaller reef enclose lagoons, two tiny coral islands and a sheer underwater wall plunging 100 metres. Divers can find some 600 fish species, 360 corals and sharks, while turtles and seabirds nest on the sands.
